text:
Carmen Ho: Quick thought 1 — we should support a graceful fallback for old embeds / share links that still use hash fragments. Proposal: primary canonical format = stable path + query params, but router should accept legacy #panel=... and map it to ?panel=... on first load (server-friendly). Also call out localization: breadcrumb labels need translatable display but permalinks should remain language-agnostic. Thoughts? :globe_with_meridians:

Ethan V.: I like that. Engineering notes: 1) server middleware should map legacy hashes to canonical queries on SSR and issue a 301 redirect when possible (helps crawlers). 2) history behavior: map legacy hash->query via replaceState so users don't get an extra back entry. 3) need whitelist of shareable params (panel, revision, range, metric). Non-shareable: ui_debug, inspectorOpen.

Sofia R.: A11y / i18n nits: for localization, keep path components English (eg. /w/acme/models) to avoid duplicate routes per locale. Use ?lang=es or Accept-Language to render labels. Breadcrumb aria-labels should be localized strings like "Ubicacif3n actual: Espacio de trabajo ACME, Modelos, modelo-xyz". When announcing via aria-live use a short template: "Current location: {workspace}, {section}, {item}" and ensure translators can reorder tokens.

Ben L.: Microcopy + UX: copy-permalink should call a server endpoint that returns the canonicalized URL (server strips ephemeral params and normalizes IDs). Show toast: "Copied canonical link" and include a short preview line (truncate long slugs). Analytics events: breadcrumb_copy, permalink_open, legacy_hash_redirect. Also: for extremely long model ids offer a "Copy ID" monospace button in the tooltip.

Carmen Ho: Example flows: 
- Incoming old link: https://console.redwood.ai/w/acme/models#panel=history&entry=7 -> server maps -> redirect/replace to https://console.redwood.ai/w/acme/models?panel=history&entry=7
- Localized UI: https://console.redwood.ai/w/acme/models?panel=metrics&lang=fr renders French labels but permalink stays canonical (no frag differences).

Ethan V.: Implementation checklist: router middleware for legacy hash mapping and canonicalizePermalink, server-side 301 for public shared links, replaceState for client-side migration, param whitelist, copy-link endpoint. I'll draft middleware and a tiny integration test.

Sofia R.: Accessibility checklist: aria-live phrasing templates per-locale, skiplink target points to currently visible main region (id changes when right panel opens), crumbs tabbable with aria-current on last item, and ensure screen reader reads localized aria-label not the raw slug. Add e2e tests for keyboard-only nav + localized announcements.

Ben L.: Visuals: breadcrumb shows short labels, tooltip reveals full id + copy icon, mobile pill opens sheet with full path + Copy. Toast includes a short URL preview and analytics payload. I'll mock copy flows and three microcopy variants.

A11yBot: Pinned: "NAV-310: Legacy-hash fallback + i18n breadcrumb checklist". Recommended tests: legacy-hash redirect, replaceState behaviour, aria-live localized announcement, skiplink landing, copy-permalink returns canonical URL.

Carmen Ho: Action items: Ethan spike legacy-hash->query + canonicalizePermalink (due Fri), Sofia write localized aria-live phrases + e2e tests (due Thu), Ben produce Figma + copy variants and toast microcopy (due Wed). Can we pilot on a non-critical workspace next sprint?

Ethan V.: :thumbsup: I'll open an RFC and push a tiny middleware PR with tests.

Sofia R.: I'll add the i18n templates to the a11y doc and schedule a brief review.

Ben L.: Will post Figma link and microcopy options here when ready.
